result:
A speck of color against the blue,
A dancing spirit, soaring true.
With slender tail of ribboned lace,
It seeks the clouds, it finds its space.

A tethered dream on a nylon string,
To the invisible currents, it learns to cling.
A tug, a pull, a sudden dive,
Feeling the wind make it come alive.

It weaves through air like a paper bird,
By the steady hand of the flyer stirred.
Up where the hawks and the eagles play,
It chases the light of the fading day.

A child’s delight, a soaring grace,
A silent traveler through endless space.
Though bound to earth by a slender line,
It reaches for heights where the sunbeams shine.

function.name: search_engine_query
function.description: Conducts a search based on the provided prompt and returns relevant real-time information, specific details, or general facts from various sources, including internet browsing and data from Google. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

prompt.description: The search query to be executed by the search engine. Example: 'latest scientific discoveries'.

since_year.description: Filter results to include only information published after the specified year. Default to the current year if not provided.

source.description: Preferred source for the search results, such as 'all', 'internet', or 'google'.

include_facts.description: Indicates whether to include factual information in the search results. Default is true.

function.name: generate_image
function.description: Generate an image based on a given text prompt. The function is versatile and can be used for various general purposes without specializing in any specific category. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

prompt.description: The text prompt that describes the desired content of the image.

image_format.description: The file format for the output image.

width.description: The width of the generated image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the generated image in pixels.

color_mode.description: The color mode of the image.

function.name: generate_human_image
function.description: Generates a realistic image of a human based on the provided prompt, with options for creating images representing different age groups and genders. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

prompt.description: A descriptive text guiding the generation of the human image, such as 'a smiling girl with blue eyes' or 'an elderly man playing chess'.

image_quality.description: The desired quality of the generated image, affecting the level of detail and realism. Options include 'low', 'medium', and 'high'.

include_background.description: Determines whether a background should be included in the generated image.

output_format.description: Specifies the file format for the output image.
